scope: preproduction technical QA; does not authorize P1-007/P1-008 or replace physical-iPhone quality review
research_basis: WebKit Safari 15.4+: svh/lvh/dvh exist specifically for mobile browser viewport changes; 100dvh tracks the dynamic viewport.
MDN viewport meta: viewport-fit=cover should be paired with safe-area inset handling so important content is not obscured.
MDN VisualViewport: visual viewport resize/scroll metrics describe presentation geometry and can change independently of layout viewport; they are not gameplay-state authority.
MDN Pointer Events: touch-action controls native gesture handling; browser gesture takeover can fire pointercancel.
MDN Pointer Events: direct-manipulation touch gets implicit pointer capture; explicit capture can preserve continuity when required and is released on pointerup/pointercancel.
MDN Pointer Events: isPrimary identifies the primary pointer, allowing deterministic rejection of secondary simultaneous touches for a single-pointer game action.
authorization_boundary: This contract may constrain future implementation and QA only. It does not activate P1-007/P1-008, authorize multi-car gameplay, or replace the pending V7.3 physical-iPhone Human review.
